text:
mika: Heads-up: finalizing a focused base-image rebuild (prod+staging). Goal: minimal blast radius. Main action items: narrow signer SA, KMS audit sink, vuln triage window, and rollback play.

dena: Sounds good. Which pods/namespaces are in the canary?

mika: Canary set: infra-canary namespace (non-customer traffic) -> then gradual label-based rollout to 20% traffic.

anya: RBAC proposal: create service account `sig-fleet@infra` with only cloudkms.sign permissions and no registry pushes. Put binding in an expiring IAM policy (30d).

tom: Agree. Also add IAM condition limiting use to signer nodes IP range. Example cond: `request.time < timestamp("2026-04-30T00:00:00Z") && request.auth.claims.k8s.nodePool=="signer-pool"`.

mika: Good. For signing, we prefer KMS-enveloped keys and remote signers (no raw priv keys on disk). Do we have glue for cosign+KMS?

anya: cosign + KMS works fine. We'll use a small signing service that proxies cosign calls to KMS and stamps a label with `rebuild=2026-04-06`. The service will mint a short-lived token scoped to sign-only.

sec-oncall: Preflight slot booked Mon 08:30 PT. Please attach rollback commands.

mika: Rollback checklist draft: 1) scale new-image replicas to 0 or re-set image tag to previous, 2) revoke signer tokens, 3) rotate ephemeral key wrappers if compromised, 4) notify downstream teams.

anya: For audit logging: create a sink in secure-audit that captures `protoPayload.methodName:("AsymmetricSign" OR "Encrypt") OR protoPayload.serviceName:"cloudkms.googleapis.com"` and add label `rebuild=2026-04-06`. We should also surfice registry signature artifacts to long-term storage (GCS) in case registry drops them.

dena: I'll own the logging sink PR. I'll include the gcloud CLI snippet in the description.

mika: Firewall: signer nodes must only reach KMS, registry, and internal telemetry. No general egress. Can infra validate?

tom: Yup. I'll open a firewall change with allowed destinations: kms.googleapis.com, registry.prod.redwood, telemetry.redwood-internal. Put a deny-all else rule.

infra-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2123 (firewall)

anya: We also need a small smoke test: pull the signed image in a fresh node, verify cosign verify, and run a simple inference of 10 requests to check cold-start latency. If latency increases > 150ms median, abort.

mika: Add that to preflight. Also add an alert rule: if 5xx rate > 1.5% over 3 minutes in canary, auto-pause rollout. Who wires the alert?

dena: SRE can wire the alert. I'll cc eng-sre on the PR.

sec-oncall: Add a quick last-used query snippet for signer SA: `gcloud logging read "protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\"sig-fleet@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com\"" --limit 1 --project=secure-audit` — put this in runbook.

anya: Registry signatures: our registry supports OCI signatures but some older proxies drop them. Plan B: store the cosign signature bundle into `gs://secure-signatures/rebuilds/2026-04-06/` as a backup.

mika: Perfect. Who will run the actual signing fleet? small ops rotation?

tom: Ops + infra engineer pair for the window. We'll keep a kill-switch script to revoke tokens and scale down the signer deployment. Example: `kubectl scale deploy signer --replicas=0 && gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable KEY_ID`

anya: Slight nuance: don't disable the SA key; revoke the keystore-issued signing tokens. The SA must remain for quick re-sign if needed.

mika: Noted. PRs to open: 1) IAM binding with expiry & condition, 2) logging sink, 3) firewall allowlist, 4) signature-archive lifecycle rule. Label all PRs `base-rebuild-2026-04-06`.

dena: I'll open the logging + signature-archive PRs.

infra-bot: checklist created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runbooks/issues/678 (auto)

sec-oncall: One last ask: include contact list for 30m post-cutover triage: sec-oncall, mika, dena, tom, eng-sre.

mika: Will add. Thanks team — syncing Mon preflight, cutover Tue. Ping here if blockers.

anya: Quick follow-up: add a test that verifies the registry preserves signature annotations on mirror pushes. If mirror strips them, write mirror to blobstore and attach metadata.

mika: Done. Closing thread.
